race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (54)
race.comment: ADMIRED (1) is the proven staying veteran, coming back from a BM66+ after charging home to win a 1MW two starts ago in good order, with that figure standing up. Finds the right race today and can bounce back to winning ways. DANDY'S GEM (6) bounced back last start at Northam with a strong effort over this trip. That effort stacks right up and this looks to shape similarly. Can go one better without surprising. CAPABLE ANGEL (7) has been honest in stronger mid-week and CL3 company, though 2200m is new territory. Racing well and can feature if she handles the rise in distance. CONSOLIDATED (2) finished just behind DANDY'S GEM last start and has claims on the back of that effort.
